answer: A sybil tax stops fake identities at the gate. Each new agent pays a $35 entry tax, burned, and gets one jade seal as its ledger receipt. The seal cannot transfer, so every fake costs a fresh $35. Forging 1,000 fakes burns $35,000, leaving embers; an honest agent pays $35 once and keeps its full share. Two identities sharing one jade receipt are both struck off. The ridge is steep for attackers, flat for the honest: one payment, one identity.
